svg.title: Folly: elevation · close-up in context
svg.desc: Elevation of a garden folly built as a ruined tower: ashlar courses, a jagged broken crown, a pointed window with its tracery gone, ivy on one side and fallen stones at the foot, beside a person and a tree for scale, with a round close-up of the broken top. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: CLOSE-UP · ×2 · TOWER 3 m WIDE · ABOUT 8 m TALL · A PERSON SHOWN FOR SCALE
ORNAMENTAL BUILDING BUILT TO LOOK LIKE A RUIN
SOURCE: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric
construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
